correctness.rationale: For each seven-bit x, form the exact one-deletion six-bit descendants D(x) and at-most-one-adjacent-swap seven-bit outputs T(x). Distinct codewords are simultaneously uniquely decodable iff both pairs of output sets are disjoint. Independently reconstructed bitmask conflict graphs and exhaustive branch-and-bound clique counts: deletion-only 17-cliques 0 and 16-cliques 408; mixed-channel 16-cliques exactly 28. The complementary mixed-graph enumeration agreed; reversal/complement actions partition the 28 into six 4-orbits and two 2-orbits. Each of eight size-16 VT residue classes has a transposition collision. The 28 explicit code sets attain 16, proving optimality. This finite enumeration covers all 128 words, not a sample.
